Require informed claimant consent without treating storm urgency as automatic consent.
Check liens, creditor interests, and injunctions before any transfer.

social_rules: A seized object remains identifiable and unaltered until a stamped judgment permits return, auction, destruction, or reclamation.
Every seizure inventory must receive a public review after seven days; missing entries weaken both custody and contraband claims.
Access certification requires measured travel time and safe passage across published tide thresholds, not merely a drawn route.
Emergency shoreline necessity may accelerate a hearing but does not extinguish ownership, lien, or restitution claims.
Anyone proposing a coastal defense must disclose which ward gains protection, which route is occupied, and where downcurrent scour may increase.
Claim marks, serial plates, family modifications, and storm damage are preserved as ownership evidence until judicial release.
No tide gate serving a public route may be privately scheduled without a recorded covenant and an enforceable override.
Objects incorporated into reversible works retain separate identities; irreversible incorporation requires explicit judgment and restitution review.
Hearing order is procedural leverage: claimants, engineers, access witnesses, and hazard evidence must all receive a recorded opportunity to answer.
Sabotage that creates immediate flood or navigation danger is prohibited, while peaceful path occupation and petitioned work stoppages remain contestable civic acts.
Generated gameplay loops should create follow-up choices instead of dead ends.
Player entry points should remain understandable through local conversation, movement, and inspection.

open_action_examples.action_name: Offer berth priority for a public gate covenant
open_action_examples.situation: Commercial berth users offer scheduled priority and maintenance funds in exchange for accepting an enforceable all-tide public override at Outer Ward All-Tide Landing.
coordinator_checks: Confirm the initiating party controls the offered berth priority or has authority from the Harbor Merchants Compact.
Confirm funds and scheduling rights are transferable and not already pledged.
Verify both parties are present or represented with recorded consent; do not infer neighborhood consent from either role.
Check that the covenant cannot waive published access thresholds or bind nonconsenting route users.
Apply no status until the terms, duration, breach remedy, and public override are recorded.

open_action_examples.action_name: Dedicate removable hull ribs to a claimant
open_action_examples.situation: At Confiscated Works Assembly Slip, selected ribs would remain removable and reserved for return while the rest of a released hull supports a temporary ramp.
coordinator_checks: Verify the judgment permits separation and reversible use of the hull.
Confirm ownership of each rib through matching inventory numbers and preserved claim marks.
Require consent from the lawful custodian and recipient before assigning reserved possession.
Confirm both roles are at the object or have authorized handlers within the work boundary.
Limit creation to a tagged, finite rib set; prohibit creating extra material or duplicating title.
Do not grant reserved status if removal would violate the engineering safety score.

open_action_examples.action_name: Declare a witness a protected tide-route reporter
open_action_examples.situation: After targeted testimony about concealed route closures and scour at Downcurrent Scour Watch, the examiner asks that the witness receive a limited public-interest status.
coordinator_checks: Check that the initiating role may request but not unilaterally confer formal protection.
Verify the testimony concerns personally observed tides, routes, or scour and is not fabricated by coordinator fiat.
Obtain the target's consent before publicly attaching the status.
Confirm the relevant testimony was delivered in proximity to an authorized record keeper or entered into a hearing record.
Bound the status by duration, protections, duties, and revocation process; do not imply immunity from unrelated violations.

open_action_examples.action_name: Exchange restitution credit for early component release
open_action_examples.situation: A claimant proposes accepting a larger recorded restitution credit in exchange for releasing non-heirloom components from a disputed seizure before final disposition.
coordinator_checks: Confirm the claimant owns or controls the specific compensation claim and may settle it.
Verify the custodian has no unilateral power to release property absent a court order or valid settlement authority.
Identify each component in the seven-day manifest and preserve excluded heirloom components intact.
Require informed claimant consent without treating storm urgency as automatic consent.
Check liens, creditor interests, and injunctions before any transfer.
Cap restitution credit to an auditable valuation and do not create currency, title, or components beyond the recorded settlement.

visual_consistency_rules: Render strict top-down compact 1:2 figures with broad shoulders and simple hands.
Use a one-pixel #242b2d contour and minimal internal lines; no soft antialias haze.
Limit each sprite to one dominant garment family, one role cue, and one primary prop.
Keep the world palette centered on #667a78, #d6c8a8, #c53b32, #242b2d, and #e8e2cf.
Reserve #c53b32 for evidence tags, claim tokens, closure cues, and small legal accents.
Never place readable text, numerals, logos, or detailed badge faces on clothing or props.
Use matte salt-worn cloth, waxed canvas, dull rubber, and oxidized metal; avoid gloss and gradients.
Differentiate roles through helmet, cap, robe wedge, hood, ledger, survey wheel, or stake rather than facial detail.
Keep carried tools chunky and visible within the 64x64 silhouette; avoid clusters of tiny accessories.
Apply compact map-northwest lighting and a small #242b2d contact shadow only.

gameplay_loops.label: Covenant, Access, and Legitimacy

gameplay_loops.pressure: Merchant schedules offer funding and maintenance, but unequal exceptions can turn certification into evidence of institutional favoritism.

gameplay_loops.pressure: Storm urgency rewards irreversible construction, while each embedded object raises compensation liability and distrust.

institutions.name: Marrowkey Forfeiture Court
institutions.mandate: Determine whether seized objects are contraband, returnable property, or lawful material for coastal works.
institutions.decision_rule: A judge weighs documented ownership, public danger, and shoreline necessity after adversarial hearings.
institutions.enforced_by: Court bailiffs, evidence clerks, and seizure warrants.
institutions.visible_output: Stamped judgments assigning each object to return, auction, destruction, or reclamation.

institutions.name: Shoreline Works Board
institutions.mandate: Design and maintain coastal defenses and public sea approaches using court-released objects.
institutions.decision_rule: Projects require an engineering safety score and majority approval weighted by residents protected.
institutions.enforced_by: Licensed salvage crews, inspectors, and control of construction permits.
institutions.visible_output: Changing seawalls, ramps, breakwaters, work barges, and posted project maps.

institutions.name: Tide Access Commission
institutions.mandate: Preserve practical, equitable routes from every neighborhood to the sea.
institutions.decision_rule: No project is certified unless measured travel time and safe tidal access remain within published thresholds.
institutions.enforced_by: Access injunctions, route closures, and withheld occupancy certificates.
institutions.visible_output: Color-coded access maps, tide gates, marked paths, and compliance notices.

institutions.name: Island Customs Service
institutions.mandate: Intercept prohibited cargo and secure objects awaiting judicial disposition.
institutions.decision_rule: Officers seize items on probable cause, with mandatory inventory review after seven days.
institutions.enforced_by: Harbor patrols, bonded warehouses, and vessel holds.
institutions.visible_output: Seizure tags, warehouse manifests, impounded craft, and public auction calendars.

state_variables.label: Usable Confiscated Material Stock
state_variables.initial_tension: Warehouses are crowded, but ownership disputes make much of the stock unavailable.

state_variables.label: Shoreline Configuration
state_variables.initial_tension: An eroding coast is defended by fragmented structures that redirect currents and foot traffic.

state_variables.label: Neighborhood Sea Access
state_variables.initial_tension: Upland wards rely on two narrow lanes, while wealthy harbor blocks control the safest landings.

state_variables.label: Coastal Hazard Exposure
state_variables.initial_tension: Several low wards face immediate storm risk, while protective works may transfer erosion down-current.

state_variables.label: Forfeiture System Legitimacy
state_variables.initial_tension: Residents support action against smugglers but distrust the conversion of disputed possessions into public infrastructure.

state_variables.label: Unresolved Claimant Case Pressure
state_variables.initial_tension: Owners, families, and creditors are filing claims faster than the courthouse can hear them.

causal_links.trigger: The court releases durable vehicles, hulls, or masonry for a named coastal project.
causal_links.effect: Designers gain new structural options and can extend or reshape defenses.

causal_links.trigger: A new barrier blocks waves but also occupies an established landing or redirects a tidal channel.
causal_links.effect: Some routes become safer while another neighborhood loses direct or low-tide passage.
causal_links.delay: Immediate for paths; several tides for channel changes.

causal_links.trigger: Breakwaters trap sediment on their protected side and accelerate scouring down-current.
causal_links.effect: Protected blocks face less flooding while distant blocks inherit greater erosion risk.

causal_links.trigger: Access maps show repeated gains for courthouse and harbor districts but losses for outer wards.
causal_links.effect: Residents withdraw cooperation, challenge projects, and treat confiscated-object construction as dispossession.

causal_links.trigger: Public trust falls and witnesses stop helping Customs establish ownership and contraband chains.
causal_links.effect: Hearings require more investigation, unresolved claims accumulate, and injunctions become likelier.

causal_links.trigger: Claimants obtain temporary orders preventing alteration of disputed objects.
causal_links.effect: Material is frozen in storage or removed from active work sites.
causal_links.delay: Immediate upon injunction, potentially lasting months.

causal_links.trigger: A newly exposed ward demands emergency protection before the next major storm.
causal_links.effect: Officials accelerate releases and consume reserve materials, leaving fewer options for later projects.

causal_links.trigger: Improved landings expand fishing income and evacuation capacity in previously isolated wards.
causal_links.effect: Residents become more willing to report smuggling and accept carefully reviewed public reuse.

stakeholder_groups.name: Outer Ward Shore Coalition
stakeholder_groups.goal: Secure permanent, all-tide public routes and protection without inheriting redirected erosion.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Mass hearings, path occupations, local tide records, and votes on municipal bonds.

social_rules: A seized object remains identifiable and unaltered until a stamped judgment permits return, auction, destruction, or reclamation.
Every seizure inventory must receive a public review after seven days; missing entries weaken both custody and contraband claims.
Access certification requires measured travel time and safe passage across published tide thresholds, not merely a drawn route.
Emergency shoreline necessity may accelerate a hearing but does not extinguish ownership, lien, or restitution claims.
Anyone proposing a coastal defense must disclose which ward gains protection, which route is occupied, and where downcurrent scour may increase.
Claim marks, serial plates, family modifications, and storm damage are preserved as ownership evidence until judicial release.
No tide gate serving a public route may be privately scheduled without a recorded covenant and an enforceable override.
Objects incorporated into reversible works retain separate identities; irreversible incorporation requires explicit judgment and restitution review.
Hearing order is procedural leverage: claimants, engineers, access witnesses, and hazard evidence must all receive a recorded opportunity to answer.
Sabotage that creates immediate flood or navigation danger is prohibited, while peaceful path occupation and petitioned work stoppages remain contestable civic acts.

coordinator_checks: Confirm the initiating party controls the offered berth priority or has authority from the Harbor Merchants Compact.

Verify both parties are present or represented with recorded consent; do not infer neighborhood consent from either role.
Check that the covenant cannot waive published access thresholds or bind nonconsenting route users.
Apply no status until the terms, duration, breach remedy, and public override are recorded.

open_action_examples.action_name: Dedicate removable hull ribs to a claimant
open_action_examples.situation: At Confiscated Works Assembly Slip, selected ribs would remain removable and reserved for return while the rest of a released hull supports a temporary ramp.
coordinator_checks: Verify the judgment permits separation and reversible use of the hull.
Confirm ownership of each rib through matching inventory numbers and preserved claim marks.
Require consent from the lawful custodian and recipient before assigning reserved possession.

Limit creation to a tagged, finite rib set; prohibit creating extra material or duplicating title.

coordinator_checks: Check that the initiating role may request but not unilaterally confer formal protection.
Verify the testimony concerns personally observed tides, routes, or scour and is not fabricated by coordinator fiat.
Obtain the target's consent before publicly attaching the status.
Confirm the relevant testimony was delivered in proximity to an authorized record keeper or entered into a hearing record.
Bound the status by duration, protections, duties, and revocation process; do not imply immunity from unrelated violations.

open_action_examples.action_name: Exchange restitution credit for early component release
open_action_examples.situation: A claimant proposes accepting a larger recorded restitution credit in exchange for releasing non-heirloom components from a disputed seizure before final disposition.
coordinator_checks: Confirm the claimant owns or controls the specific compensation claim and may settle it.
Verify the custodian has no unilateral power to release property absent a court order or valid settlement authority.
Identify each component in the seven-day manifest and preserve excluded heirloom components intact.
Require informed claimant consent without treating storm urgency as automatic consent.
Check liens, creditor interests, and injunctions before any transfer.
Cap restitution credit to an auditable valuation and do not create currency, title, or components beyond the recorded settlement.

causal_links.trigger: Public trust falls and witnesses stop helping Customs establish ownership and contraband chains.

causal_links.effect: Material is frozen in storage or removed from active work sites.

stakeholder_groups.name: Outer Ward Shore Coalition
stakeholder_groups.goal: Secure permanent, all-tide public routes and protection without inheriting redirected erosion.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Mass hearings, path occupations, local tide records, and votes on municipal bonds.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: Depends on safe landings, affordable transport, and access certification.

stakeholder_groups.name: Dispossessed Owners and Claimants
stakeholder_groups.goal: Recover seized objects intact or receive compensation before they become irreversible infrastructure.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Title evidence, injunction requests, creditor liens, and testimony exposing wrongful seizure.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: Depends on court access, traceable inventories, legal aid, and objects remaining identifiable.

stakeholder_groups.name: Salvage Builders Guild
stakeholder_groups.goal: Maintain a predictable flow of unusual materials and win long-term shoreline contracts.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Engineering expertise, cranes, work barges, and the ability to certify or refuse hazardous builds.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: Depends on court releases, safe designs, permit continuity, and prompt payment.

stakeholder_groups.name: Harbor Merchants Compact
stakeholder_groups.goal: Keep commercial berths and customs channels unobstructed while concentrating defenses around the trading harbor.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Tax revenue, shipping schedules, warehouse capacity, and threatened diversion of trade.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: Depends on navigable channels, rapid customs clearance, and reliable storm protection.
